name: ToT Clean
reference: The cleans of Train of Thought (Dream Theater, 2003, prod. Petrucci and Portnoy): the Endless Sacrifice intro, In the Name of God
rig: Petrucci used 'one head and one 4x12 cabinet for everything', miked, recorded 'mostly dry', with 'a couple of songs where I recorded through a chorus pedal at the front' (BOSS Users Group); which songs isn't documented. The head was a Mesa Road King with a Rectifier 4x12 of Vintage 30s (musicplayers.com). Endless Sacrifice is D standard and In the Name of God C standard (forum lore). The clean channel's settings aren't documented
notes: Plays on the clean TONE3000 ("instance": "clean", experiments D32) for the Clean Chorus, on at load: 0.6 Hz, 3 ms, 40 % (estimates of the chorus pedal Petrucci mentions). Amp: Mesa Mark IIC+ 'Yummy Clean' into a Mesa 4x12 V30 SM57, not the documented Road King, because both Road King clean captures that load broke up under the JP70 (THD -17 to -21 dB at -12 dBFS input, D32), and the Road King II clean capture won't download. Warmer and drier than the I&W clean (inferred): delay 380 ms, feedback 0.2, mix 0.15, always on; 480L Small Plate at the house level. SW8/SW9 don't reach the clean instance. Levelled offline with rigsim --exact to -15 LUFS.

chorus.note: Estimate of the chorus pedal 'at the front'.
